# Harness marks

- `cursor.svg`: Cursor 2D cube, light-background variant, from the [official brand asset kit](https://cursor.com/brand).
- `pi.svg`: the [official Pi logo download](https://pi.dev/logo-auto.svg).
- `codex.svg`: the Codex app logo, in colour — the blossom outline holding a white `>_` prompt, filled with a vertical lavender-to-blue gradient `#B1A7FF → #7A9DFF → #3941FF`. The outline and `>_` paths come from the `codex` icon, and the gradient values from the `codex-color` icon, of [`@lobehub/icons-static-svg`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@lobehub/icons-static-svg) 1.102.0 (MIT licence, Copyright (c) 2023 LobeHub, [full text](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons/blob/master/LICENSE), source: [lobehub/lobe-icons](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons)). The geometry is unchanged; Ensemble only recomposed it so that the whole outline carries the gradient and the `>_` is painted on top in white (no tile behind it). The gradient is an interface rendering of the colours of the logo the Codex app itself ships, not a byte-exact official file. The mark itself is OpenAI's: it is shown only to identify the Codex harness, OpenAI's [design guidelines](https://openai.com/brand/) and trademark terms apply to it, and OpenAI does not endorse Ensemble.
- `claude-code.svg`: the Claude Code mascot from [Simple Icons](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/blob/fd14b05fa2a533f1f0cfa7f297971d82947beeb9/icons/claudecode.svg), shown in the Claude Code brand color; Anthropic's [trademark guidelines](https://www.anthropic.com/legal) apply to the mark.
- `opencode.svg`: the OpenCode logo, unmodified — the file `opencode-logo-transparent-light.svg` (the *Default* logo, light version) from the project's [brand guidelines page](https://opencode.ai/brand), fetched 2026-11-16. It is not recoloured, cropped or altered in any way. "OpenCode and the OpenCode logo are trademarks of Anomaly": the logo is shown only to identify the OpenCode harness, Anomaly's brand guidelines apply to it, and Anomaly does not endorse or sponsor Ensemble. The page publishes brand guidelines rather than an open-source licence for the files; at the small sizes of some of Ensemble's slots the logo is drawn below the guidelines' 16 × 20 px minimum (details in `src/web/marks/README.md`).
- `dsh.svg`: the DSH (DeepSeek Harness) mark, unmodified — the light-background favicon `apps/web/public/favicon.svg` of the [deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) repository (MIT licence, Copyright (c) 2026 DeepSeek, [full text](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/LICENSE)), fetched 2026-11-16. It is the DeepSeek whale, the one logo the DSH web app itself uses; it is shown only to identify the DSH harness. "DeepSeek Harness" is a registered trademark of DeepSeek, its [brand guidelines](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/BRAND_GUIDELINES.md) apply to the mark, and DeepSeek does not endorse or sponsor Ensemble.

These marks identify the respective harnesses. They are not the Ensemble logo; the names and marks remain their owners' trademarks.
